sum: iPower Inc. operates as technology- and data-driven infrastructure company in the United States. It engages in digital treasury activities and supply chain management business. The company was formerly known as BZRTH Inc. and changed its name to iPower Inc. in September 2020. iPower Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Rancho Cucamonga, California.
ceo: Mr. Chenlong  Tan (Co-Founder, Chairman, CEO, President, Interim CFO & Secretary)
